name: run_length
description: Run-length encode or decode text; every run is written as <count><char> (e.g. "aaabbbbc" -> "3a4b1c"), so decoding never confuses a literal digit in the input with a count (C++). WHEN TO USE: compressing sparse, repetitive text (simple bitmaps, padded data dumps). Input: {"text": "...", "mode": "encode"|"decode"} (mode defaults to encode; bare text may be passed unwrapped for encode).

mode.description: encode or decode. Defaults to encode.
